text:
sam: Heads-up: eu1 subpool A spiked 5xx and p95 right after the deploy. Canary passed initially but spike started as traffic shifted to subpool A. Suspect allocation regression in model-redwood-3.2.1. Need quick mitigation, prefer minimal blast radius.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Alert: eu1-subpool-A /generate 5xx=14% (5m). Canary overall 10% but subpool A is hot. Active: model-redwood-3.2.1 on subpool A. Suggested: roll subpool A back to 3.1.9 or pin regionally. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/fast-rollback

ops-lead: If a single subpool shows >=10% for 5m, we can do a targeted rollback to that subpool. Approve expedited subpool rollback/pin. Keep other subpools on 3.2.1 for now.

anya: +1. Targeted approach reduces customer impact. Note: tokenizer differences could surface for requests routed to different subpools for the same customer session — warn CS.

sam: I'll initiate a subpool rollback. Command below.

sam: ```
/deploy subpool-rollback eu1 subpool-A --from model-redwood-3.2.1 --to model-redwood-3.1.9 --reason "subpool-A 5xx spike" --ticket INC-4001
```

deploy-bot: Command received. Verifying perms and preflight. Preflight: capacity OK; dependency check: model artifacts available. Proceeding with subpool rollback, 4-step ramp per node.

carol: Running quick smoke against sticky-session prompts to detect cross-subpool tokenization deltas.

releasebot: Drafting release note: "Targeted rollback: eu1 subpool-A -> v3.1.9 due to increased 5xx and latency after v3.2.1 push. Other subpools remain on 3.2.1. Investigation in progress. Postmortem INC-4001." Draft PR: https://go/redwood/prs/6012

ops-lead: Monitor session-stickiness edge cases. If we see customers hitting mixed-subpool outputs, consider a temporary routing rule to direct sessions away from the rolled subpool until stable.

carol: smoke: generation sanity OK, p95 back to baseline on subpool-A after step 2 of ramp. No 5xx in 10-check suite.

deploy-bot: Subpool rollback complete. subpool-A now running model-redwood-3.1.9. eu1-subpool-A 5xx rolling avg 0.5% over 3m; overall eu1 5xx 1.2%.

support: Notifying CS: targeted rollback applied for subpool-A. Preparing support note about possible minor output diffs for sessions that were load-balanced across subpools during the incident.

anya: Good containment. Next: collect heap/gpu dumps from affected nodes, stash traces, and determine if a 3.2.2 build fixes allocation regression. Also add a canary gate on per-subpool metrics (not just aggregate).

ops-lead: Agreed. Keep this subpool pinned to 3.1.9 for 2 hours. If stable, open a follow-up PR to add per-subpool canary gating and improve sticky-routing to avoid mixed outputs.

sam: Filed INC-4001 and added owners for telemetry (carol), canary gating (anya), and CS communications (support).

releasebot: Release note published and customer blurb queued for CS. PR link: https://go/redwood/prs/6012. Postmortem template: https://go/redwood/postmortems/INC-4001

sam: Thanks team — closing fast-path. I'll keep watching metrics for 60m and will reopen if anything regresses.
